companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company page URLs or slugs. Accepts: https://www.linkedin.com/company/apple/, https://www.linkedin.com/company/apple/about/, or just the slug: apple
companyUrls.title: Company URLs

cookie.description: Optional LinkedIn session cookie. The public company page is read without a cookie. Supply a valid session only when you need funding details, exact office locations, affiliates or showcase pages.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie

includeAffiliates.description: Also emit one record per affiliated company referenced by each input company.
includeAffiliates.title: Include affiliated companies

includeFundingDetails.description: Extract Crunchbase funding info (total raised, last round, lead investors) from the LinkedIn page when available. Adds small fetch time.
includeFundingDetails.title: Include funding details

includeShowcases.description: Also emit one record per LinkedIn showcase page referenced by each input company.
includeShowcases.title: Include showcase pages

language.description: Language code used for Accept-Language and the LinkedIn lang cookie.
language.title: Language

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxy recommended for best results.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
